rows.label: R{refinement} passive: Seasoned Symphony
rows.template: ATK +{param:atk}% (on the character screen); off the field +{param:atk}% more. After she heals, she and the healed character get +{param:echo}% ATK for 3 s.
rows.note: The healed character: the member on the field (her Q heals the whole party, so off-field members miss it here).

passive.name: Seasoned Symphony
descriptions: ATK is increased by 12%. When the equipping character is off-field, ATK is increased by an additional 12%. After initiating healing, the equipping character and the character(s) they have healed will obtain the "Sweet Echoes" effect, increasing their ATK by 32% for 3s. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is off-field.
